# Embedded skill: descriptive-statistics

# Descriptive statistics

Run stats on a fetched table. Do not skip a profile because the schema looked complete.

## Panja runtime

```text
python scripts/summarize.py --input /tmp/rows.json --column amount
```

Scripts consume already-fetched `{ "rows": [...] }`.

## When to use which number

| See | Prefer | Avoid as the headline |
|---|---|---|
| Skew (mean ≫ median) | median, p50, p90 | mean alone |
| Heavy tails / whales | p90 / trimmed or "ex-top-1%" | mean |
| Categories | mode + shares | mean of encoded labels |
| Missingness | null % + whether MNAR could explain the move | dropping NA silently |

Example: mean transaction ₹4,200 vs median ₹530 → **skew**. Say so. Do not brief leadership on the mean.

## Always pair

- Location (median or mean **if** symmetric) + spread (IQR or SD) + n + null %
- A histogram or box plot via `visualization` when the shape is the point

## STOP

- Mean of a ratio of ratios
- Dropping outliers to "clean" a drop you were asked to explain
- Correlation heatmap as a conclusion (that is exploration, not RCA)
